notes.title: The Pony Express crew is over 500k now. Shall we take some responsibility?
notes.content:
[h3]Hi there![/h3]

Come here, gather around, we have a message for you all today. 

And that message is of sincere, unbelievable gratitude. Turns out, Mouthwashing just passed 500k sales, which honestly feels more surreal than any bizzaro psychosis. Everyone, you truly are incredible and we’re extremely grateful to you for taking a part in this painful journey and on behalf of everyone here both at Wrong Organ and CR Channel we want to say

[h2]THANK YOU[/h2]

While we can’t share any cake with y’all today [spoiler]feel free to make one on your own and share with us tho[/spoiler], what we [b]can[/b] share is some news of what’s to come for Mouthwashing.

So, here goes.

[h3]MOUTHWASHING’S COMING TO CONSOLES IN PHYSICAL AND DIGITAL EDITIONS[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44578933/c90914cde7b37ee4be0dcb30bd79798ad8b14d3e.png[/img]

That’s right, we’re ready to reach new horizons and we’re expanding onto PlayStation and Nintendo consoles later this year. But wait, we can hear the unasked question: “What about the physical edition?”

We’ve got some good news for you too, our imaginary collector friend! We partnered with Fangamer to bring Mouthwashing into the physical form, so you can have Curly’s unblinking eye staring at you from its cover at all times.

[b][url=https://www.fangamer.com/pages/mouthwashing-physical-edition]Sign up now at Fangamer[/url][/b]

But that’s not all: we’ll be also launching Mouthwashing merch such as apparel, plushies, vinyl and more in collaboration with Fangamer later this year. Stay tuned for more news coming soon your way!

And as we wrap up for today, once again, thank you so much for your support of Mouthwashing and us here at Wrong Organ. We love and cherish every single one of you and we hope to gather ‘round again like this when we reach 999,000 sales.

In the meantime, why won’t you go play our previous game, How Fish is Made? It’s free, localized into lots of languages, is full of grotesque creatures, philosophical dilemmas [b]and[/b] has a neat electro swing interlude.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1854430/How_Fish_Is_Made/

[i]Be kind. Stay safe. Don’t be daft.

See you next time,
Wrong Organ & CR Channel[/i]

notes.title: Mouthwashing — A little update and a big community spotlight
notes.content:
[h3]Hi there![/h3]

We just launched a little update for Mouthwashing, but it’s more of an opportunity for us to chat with you all, really. How’s 2025 treating you so far, does it hurt less? 

[i]Good.[/i]

Let’s start with the actual patch notes first:

[list]
[*] Vietnamese community localization added
[*] Finally removed the ability to wipe your achievement progress by accident (sorry about that)
[*] Various small fixes
[/list]

Now, we didn’t win the Steam Award for Best Narrative, but it was never about the destination, really. We’d like to sincerely thank everyone who voted for us and who helped us make it into the Quite Stacked Shortlist of Steam Awards.

And here’s our thanks in form of a short video by our dear friend Joetastic, please enjoy the Post-Steam Awards Special:

[previewyoutube=qv0-i9eEhu0;full][/previewyoutube]

That being said, there’s still a chance to win at [b]DIGY Awards[/b]! If you’d like to show us even more of your support, consider voting for Mouthwashing in the [b][url=https://digyawards.com/AudChoice]Audience Choice nomination[/url][/b] and thank you so much yet again <3

Phew, and with that out of the way let’s jump into our regularly scheduled [i]‘holy shit how is our community so talented, we don’t deserve them’[/i] part of the devlog.

It’s incredibly hard not to make this section into a 50-page long mess, but with an aching heart we got down to like 10 fan arts or so. However we encourage you to go on Twitter (or X or whatever else you wanna call it) and go through the #Mouthwashing hashtag, there’s some pure gold in here!

Oh, and if you are [i]creating[/i] fan-art and you want us to see it in any of the future community spotlights, either tag us (@Wrong_Organ) or use the #Mouthwashing hashtag, so it’ll be easier for us to find!

[b]Spoiler Alert: If you haven’t completed Mouthwashing by this point, we highly encourage you to go play it first. Full spoilers ahead![/b]

notes.title: Mouthwashing — Thank you for playing!
notes.content:
Hi there!

Wow, what a wild ride this week has been.

It’s incredibly hard to express how grateful we are to all of you who played Mouthwashing. Seeing your fan arts, playthroughs and discussions of our game feels even better than expected once we crossed the finish line. So here goes…

[h2]WRONG ORGAN SAYS:[/h2]
[h1]“THANK YOU”[/h1]

But that’s not all of course. As Mouthwashing devs, we bear the [i]responsibility[/i] of making our game as best as we possibly can, so we’ve just launched a patch based on the feedback we received from you all throughout the week.

Here’s what you can find in it:

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] FOV setting added to LaunchOptions.dat file (FieldOfView = 100).
[*] Dithering setting added to the LaunchOptions.dat file (DitheringEnabled = true).
[*] You can now open [spoiler]the Developer menu[/spoiler] on controller (by pressing L3 and R3 simultaneously).
[*] Added Cursor Speed setting to the options menu.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements not unlocking properly.
[*] [spoiler]Swansea’s fight was adjusted to make hitting him more forgiving.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Horse monster was reworked to be less aggressive and easier to read for the player.[/spoiler]
[*] Updated English, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian and Traditional Chinese localizations.
[*] Fixed timeline inconsistencies.
[*] Fixed certain environmental interactions being inaccessible and/or showing the wrong dialog.
[*] Re-made texture on News From Corporate model to be canon.
[*] Fixed Swansea having the wrong texture in Ch21.
[*] [spoiler]Fixed music cutting out when Curly is on fire.[/spoiler]
[*] Scrambled text in chapter intros was fixed to actually spell [spoiler]“Take Responsibility” [/spoiler] properly.
[/list]

And last but not least, we wanted to give a spotlight to some of the fan arts of Mouthwashing we caught on Twitter throughout the week and loved the most! We might make this into a regular thing, so if you want us to see your piece of fan work on Twitter, either tag us ([url=x.com/Wrong_Organ]@Wrong_Organ[/url]) or use the #Mouthwashing hashtag, so it’ll be easier for us to find!

[b]Oh, and spoiler warning! You might want to finish the game first before you scroll further.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44578933/98b93052238d02112366749bc45bad55b8db1f60.jpg[/img]
[h3]Let’s eat. Let’s survive.[/h3](via [url=https://x.com/GlassCaskcut/status/1841339486950592786]GlassCaskcut[/url] on Twitter)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44578933/90fc1e9a5379cd5e37ddcace8622bb49963ce2c6.jpg[/img]

And that only barely scratches the surface of how much awesome art of Mouthwashing we’ve seen so far, but we can’t put all of it in here cuz otherwise this devlog would be thrice as long, so we’ll wrap up here instead.

But before we go: a lot of you were asking about the Mouthwashing OST and Trading Cards, so we can confirm that both will be coming soon!

Once again, thank you so much for your support and passion for Mouthwashing and we can’t wait to leave as much of an impact on you with our next project!

[i]We know it hurt.
Hope it feels better now.

Wrong Organ & CR Channel[/i]

notes.title: Updated Demo — New Localizations
notes.content:
[h3]Hey horror fans![/h3]

We’re excited to tell you that we’ve expanded the Mouthwashing library of languages. We’ll keep adding more to make sure an even wider audience can experience the surreal horror of surviving a shipwreck (and the perils of excessive mouth washing, of course).

What more horrors await you in the full version? Only time will tell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44578933/f21a8bc1e18a80963a3c25a3387357d8acbff274.png[/img]

Below you can find a list of current changes in the new version of the demo.

[b]Localization changes:[/b]
- Japanese;
- Polish;
- Portuguese - Brazil;
- Russian;
- Simplified Chinese;
- Spanish - LATAM;
and more languages coming soon.

[b]Additionally:[/b]
- Minor content changes;
- Bug fixes and other improvements.

The updated demo is already available on the store page. Give it a shot,  see if you can spot the changes we've made!

Don’t forget to wishlist Mouthwashing, if you haven’t already, and join the CR Channel Discord server to stay updated on all future developments!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475490/Mouthwashing/

Over and out,

Wrong Organ and Critical Reflex.
